daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Scorpio. Trust that magnetic pull you're feeling—it's pointing you toward something real. Channel that intensity into something creative or meaningful.
daily.love: There's a softness in your vibe that's hard to resist right now. Whether you're coupled or single, your authenticity is your superpower. Let someone see the real you beneath the mystery.
daily.career: A conversation or collaboration you've been hesitant about could actually open doors. Your strategic mind is sharp today—speak up with confidence and watch how people respond to your vision.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance. That restless energy you feel? Channel it into movement that feels good—dancing, stretching, walking. Mental clarity follows when you honor what your physical self needs.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to trust your gut instincts, Scorpio. Mercury's movement is blessing you with clarity about what actually matters. It's giving introspective, grounded vibes—perfect for releasing what no longer serves.
weekly.love: Your magnetic energy is peaked right now. If you're single, someone might be noticing. If coupled up, deep conversations are flowing naturally. Either way, vulnerability is your superpower this week. Let people see the real you.
weekly.career: You're getting major ideas and creative momentum. Channel that intense Scorpio focus into projects that genuinely excite you. Collaboration over competition is the move—your network has your back more than you realize.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding practices this week. Think: long walks, stretching, whatever helps you feel present. Your energy is potent, so channel it through movement rather than letting it sit stagnant.
